metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "A customer of the insurance company who reports claims and tracks their progress."

        claimsBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization, consulted to screen claims for fraud." "External"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization, through which claim settlements are executed." "External"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform, where policyholders report claims and claims are processed through triage, assessment, and payout." {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "The web portal where policyholders report claims and track their progress." "Web application" "Web"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "The backend that serves the insurer's mobile app." "REST API"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims." "Microservice"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims." "Microservice"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts." "Microservice"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements." "Microservice"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims." "Microservice"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports." "Microservice"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders." "Microservice"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters." "Microservice"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims." "Web application" "Web"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy." "Microservice"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners." "Microservice"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation." "Batch job"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts." "Message queue" "Queue"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records." "Relational database" "Database"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records." "Relational database" "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Relational database" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence." "Object storage" "Database"
        }

        policyholder -> webPortal "Reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS/JSON"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "Reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS/JSON"

        webPortal -> claimsIntake "Submits new claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> assessment "Requests settlement assessments from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> payout "Requests claim settlements from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> documentService "Uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> notification "Requests status notifications from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntake "Submits new claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "Requests settlement assessments from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "Requests claim settlements from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "Uploads claim photos and reports to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> notification "Requests status notifications from" "HTTPS/JSON"

        claimsIntake -> triage "Hands accepted claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        triage -> assessment "Routes claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        assessment -> payout "Requests settlements from" "HTTPS/JSON"

        fraudScreening -> claimsBureau "Consults for fraud screening" "HTTPS/JSON"
        policyVerification -> policyDb "Checks the cover against" "SQL"
        assignment -> adjusterWorkbench "Routes the claim to" "HTTPS/JSON"

        documentService -> documentStore "Reads from" "S3/REST"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDb "Reads and writes claim records" "SQL"
        batchScheduler -> policyDb "Reads and writes policy records" "SQL"
        notification -> policyholder "Reports claim status changes" "Email/SMS"
        payout -> clearingHouse "Executes settlements through" "HTTPS/JSON"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "The policyholder, the Claims Center, and the external systems it interacts with." {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "System Context for Claims Center"
        }

        container claimsCenter "ClaimSubmission" "How a policyholder reports and tracks a claim through intake, assessment, and payout." {
            include policyholder
            include webPortal
            include mobileAppBackend
            include claimsIntake
            include triage
            include assessment
            include payout
            include documentService
            include notification
            include documentStore
            include clearingHouse
            autoLayout
            title "Claim Submission and Settlement"
        }

        container claimsCenter "RiskAndData" "How claims are screened, verified, and assigned, and the data and batch processing behind them." {
            include fraudScreening
            include policyVerification
            include assignment
            include adjusterWorkbench
            include reinsuranceAllocation
            include batchScheduler
            include eventQueue
            include claimsDb
            include policyDb
            include auditDb
            include claimsBureau
            autoLayout
            title "Risk, Assignment and Data"
        }

        styles {
            element "Person" {
                shape Person
                background #08427B
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Software System" {
                background #1168BD
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "External" {
                background #999999
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Container" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Database" {
                shape Cylinder
            }
            element "Web" {
                shape WebBrowser
            }
            element "Queue" {
                shape Pipe
            }
            relationship "Relationship" {
                routing Orthogonal
            }
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope softwaresystem
    }
}
